rows.grounds: instrumental of mantra, the means of the action
demonstrative pronoun, instrumental, referring to the specified mantra
verb expressing destruction or removal of afflictions
compound: jvara+graha+viṣa+ādi; graha may denote a seizing spirit or afflicting influence

items.question: Which afflictions does recitation of this specified mantra destroy?
premises: A specific mantra is employed as the means.
This mantra possesses the power to remove afflictions.
Fevers, grahas, poisons, and similar harms are the targets.
items.inference: By this mantra, fevers, grahas, poisons, and similar afflictions perish.
uncertainties: graha may refer to a seizing spirit, planetary influence, or other afflicting agent.
items.plain_english: By this mantra, fevers, seizures by grahas, poisons, and other such afflictions are destroyed.
